subject: Re: SignalFrame, DetectionEvent, calibration
body: Taking your field names for the M1 cut: targetEmotionId, window {startT, endT, hr, rmssd, quality}, gate {consecutive, refractoryMs, sham}, calibration {hr {mean,sd}, lnRmssd {mean,sd}, windows, recordedAt}. Calibration summary lives on each Profile v2 emotion, plus a profile-level neutral; the full recording is a separate Calibration document. I'll supersede D-contracts-004 with this at M1.
